long_term_targets.source: 8-K 3-Mar-2026 Ex.99.1 '2026 A Vision & Strategy Built on Performance' (slides 6, 49-50) and earnings decks

long_term_targets.organic_sales_cagr: mid-single digits (bridge: +2.0-3.0% underlying rail industry growth, +1.0-2.0% N.A. loco fleet renewal / intl growth, +1.0% accelerated technology-driven growth)
long_term_targets.adj_op_margin_expansion_bps: 350+ (225 bps cost improvement, 85 bps revenue growth, 40 bps capital & technology investment)
long_term_targets.capital_allocation: net leverage 2.0-2.5x; capex ~2% of sales; working capital ~20% of sales; tech spend ~6-7% of sales; dividend payout 10-15% of adjusted net income; incremental margin ~31%

long_term_targets.notes: No explicit 2030 sales / margin / EPS targets were found in the 3-Mar-2026 deck (text and slide images checked); the only long-term framework is the 2025-2029 5-year outlook.
